newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Yokogawa Electric unit sees sales doubling.
newsitem.headline: Yokogawa Electric unit sees sales doubling.

text.p: Yokogawa Electric Asia (YAS), the Southeast Asian regional headquarters of Japan's Yokogawa Electric, said on Wednesday it expected its sales to double in two years.
YAS quoted its managing director, Tsuneo Jogan, as saying in a statement:
"YAS's turnover of Singapore $220 million for the financial year '96 ending March 1997 is expected to double in two years."

The statement added that, together with Yokogawa Electric's other Singapore-based unit, Yokogawa Engineering Asia, total sales from the country would reach the company's target of S$1 billion by 2000 for manufacturing, sales, engineering and service.
